import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from services.source_ingestion import controller_worker as cw
from services.source_ingestion.connectors import base
from services.source_ingestion.tests.test_scheduled_connector import admission_stack, client
from services.source_ingestion.tests.test_collector_newest_session_progress import TPEX, recorded_run

def test_native_same_second_order(admission_stack, monkeypatch):
    http, module, reads, wanted, files, transport, tick = admission_stack
    more, entry = recorded_run(TPEX, fetched='2026-11-14T06:19:33Z')
    files.update(more)
    files['bundles/index.json'] = json.dumps({'bundles':[entry]}).encode()
    files['status.json'] = json.dumps({'sources':{TPEX:{'status':'ok', 'last_run_at':entry['finished_at'], 'cadence_seconds':21600}}}).encode()
    tick(cw.RECONCILE_ONLY_MODE)
    fixed = datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0)
    monkeypatch.setattr(base, '_utc_now', lambda: fixed)
    observed = []
    for n in range(2):
        response = http.post('/api/source-ingest/run-scheduled', json={'force_connector_ids':[TPEX], 'exclusive_connector_ids':[TPEX]}, headers={'Authorization':f'Bearer {module.runtime.controller_token}'})
        assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
        assert response.json()['summary']['total_failed'] == 0, response.text
        item = next(c for c in http.get('/api/source-ingest/controller/readback').json()['connectors'] if c['connector_id'] == TPEX)
        snapshot = module.runtime.store.read_freshness_snapshot()
        observed.append({'pull':n+1, 'health':item['source_health'], 'freshness':item['freshness'],
                         'runs':[r.to_dict() for r in snapshot['runs'] if r.connector_id == TPEX],
                         'receipts':[r.to_dict() for r in snapshot['receipts'] if r.connector_id == TPEX]})
    with open('/tmp/collector-same-second-native.json', 'w') as out:
        json.dump(observed, out, indent=2, default=str)
    first, second = observed
    first_id = first['health']['metadata']['last_ingest_run_id']
    second_id = second['health']['metadata']['last_ingest_run_id']
    assert first_id != second_id
    assert second['freshness']['latest_run']['ingest_run_id'] == first_id
    assert second['runs'][0]['finished_at'] == second['runs'][1]['finished_at']
    assert second['runs'][0]['status'] == second['runs'][1]['status'] == 'completed'
    print('NATIVE_ORDER_PROOF '+json.dumps({'run_order':[r['ingest_run_id'] for r in second['runs']], 'finished_at':[r['finished_at'] for r in second['runs']], 'health_run':second_id, 'freshness_latest_run':second['freshness']['latest_run']['ingest_run_id']}))
